children: Overview
Sweden B2B casino supplier's Q3 revenue rose 3.7% yr/yr, slightly missing analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITDA margin for Q3 was 65.8%, down from 66.4% a year ago
Company temporarily closed Brazilian studio due to regulatory uncertainty, expects LatAm growth to offset impact
Outlook
Company to launch Ice Fishing in North America in Q4 2026
Evolution to launch Game Night title before end-2026
Company says Brazil regulatory changes create uncertainty; LatAm momentum expected to offset some impact
Result Drivers
REGIONAL PERFORMANCE - Co said all regions reported qtr-on-qtr growth, with strong yr/yr increases in North America, LatAm and Africa
PRODUCT SEGMENTS - Co said both Live and RNG segments grew yr/yr, with RNG up 10.1% and Live up 2.6%
NEW GAMES - Co launched several new games and a US-focused slots brand during the qtr
